newsitem.title: USA: Collins & Aikman weighs sale of Mastercraft.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Aikman weighs sale of Mastercraft.

text.p: CHARLOTTE, N.C., Dec 4 - Collins & Aikman Corp said Wednesday that it is considering selling Mastercraft Group, its principal decorative fabrics unit, to more aggressively pursue its automotive growth strategy.

The Mastercraft Group, in Spindale, N.C., is the leading maker of flat woven upholstery fabrics. Mastercraft, the group's largest division, provides a broad range of products to leading residential and office furniture manufacturers.
For the first nine months of 1996, the Mastercraft Group had net sales of $213.5 million.
